facts.fact: A Sukanya Samriddhi account can be opened only for a girl child who has not reached 10 years of age on the date of opening
facts.quote: The account may be opened by one of the guardian in the name of a girl child, who has not attained the age of ten years as on the date of opening of the account.

facts.fact: The account can be opened at post offices and authorised banks
facts.quote: Account can be opened in Post offices and in authorised banks.

facts.fact: Documents: a document for the girl's date of birth, an address document of the father, mother or legal guardian, and a photo (India Post)
facts.quote: To open the account, you need a document for the child's date of birth, a document for the address of the father, mother, or legal guardian, a photo, and an initial deposit of Rs.250 only.

facts.fact: The application to open the account is made in Form-1 with the girl's birth certificate and the guardian's documents
facts.quote: The application in Form-1 for opening an account shall be accompanied by birth certificate of the girl child in whose name the account is to be opened, along with required documents of guardian.

facts.fact: The current Sukanya Samriddhi interest rate is 8.2% per annum, compounded yearly (India Post)
facts.quote: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSA) Rate of Interest: 8.2% per annum calculated on yearly basis, Yearly compounded.

facts.fact: The rates for October-December 2026 (Q3 2026-27) were notified by DEA's OM 'Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27' dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: The 30.09.2026 OM keeps all small savings rates for Q3 2026-27 (1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026) unchanged from Q2, so the Sukanya Samriddhi rate stays at 8.2%
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter
facts.note: DEA OM F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026, read by OCR of the scanned PDF. The 8.2% Sukanya Samriddhi rate is derived: the OM gives no rates; it keeps Q2 rates, and NSI shows this rate to 30.09.2026 and India Post shows it now.

summary: Turn facts confirmed: below-10 rule and Form-1 with birth certificate (SSA Scheme 2019), post office/authorised banks (NSI), documents (India Post scheme features), 8.2% (India Post savings page); Q3 OM dated 30.09.2026 listed by DEA, its scanned content is manual.
